specification_points.description: Define transition metals; explain variable oxidation states with examples
Describe the formation of complex ions; use ligand and coordination number terminology
Explain the colour of transition metal complexes in terms of d-orbital splitting
Describe ligand substitution and precipitation reactions of copper and iron complexes
Describe the reactions of aldehydes and ketones: nucleophilic addition, reduction
Distinguish between aldehydes and ketones using Tollens' and Fehling's tests
Describe the reactions of carboxylic acids and esters (esterification, hydrolysis)
Explain the basicity of amines; describe formation of ammonium salts and amides
Describe the properties of amino acids; explain zwitterion formation
Describe the formation and hydrolysis of peptide bonds
Describe addition polymerisation and condensation polymerisation
Interpret mass spectra (molecular ion, base peak, fragmentation patterns)
Interpret NMR spectra: chemical shift, integration, splitting patterns
